title: ASL Translation
summary: Real-time American Sign Language letter recognition using deep learning and MediaPipe hand tracking.
description:
ASL Translation is a real-time system that uses a deep learning model to interpret American Sign Language letters through the user's webcam.

## How it works

- MediaPipe Hand Landmarker detects 21 key points on the user's hand
- These landmarks are preprocessed and fed into a trained deep learning model
- The model predicts which ASL letter the user is signing

## Features

- Real-time hand tracking via webcam
- Deep learning model for letter classification
- MediaPipe integration for robust landmark detection
- Clean interface showing prediction results

## Future improvements

- Extend the model to recognize full words and phrases
- Improve prediction accuracy with more training data
- Add support for dynamic gestures (movement-based signs)
idea: The goal is to bridge communication gaps by enabling real-time translation of ASL letters using computer vision and deep learning.
